MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

3. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 77

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 105
   D. 22

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
